state:
**Goal `program-enumeration` — Stage 2, the class selector, is on disk whole.** ADR 0253 records both halves of the goal, and `rule:programs/constructors` is its new rule, `status: designed` until Stage 3 lands it. `rule:programs/implementing`, `rule:programs/implementing-with` and `rule:programs/framework-refusals` are rewritten under it.

`implementing<T>` and `implementingWith<T, S>` take a class: `crates/nvs-types/src/program.rs:@selector_of` (renamed from `interface_of`) accepts `SymbolKind::Class | Interface` and reports `E0743`, whose constant is now `E_PROGRAM_TYPE_ARG_NOT_A_CLASS_OR_INTERFACE`. `nvs_hir::implementors` needed no change. `E0744`'s message now reads "`C` is a `T`". `constructors` is in `PROGRAM_SCAN_MEMBERS` and `constructors_alone_opts_the_program_into_the_scan` pins it. `implementingWith` alone already opted in before this goal (commit 49fad0d4e), so the handoff's earlier doubt there was wrong.

The reject case is renamed to `program-implementing-takes-an-interface-or-a-class-whose-classes-need-no-arguments.nvst`, and it now covers an enum, a shape and a class whose subclass needs arguments. The `Core\Program` cards, `docs/reference/lang/90-attributes.md` and `docs/novis.md` say "interface or class". The two `about.md` files are incomplete rather than false, and Stage 4 rewrites them whole.

items.text: **The registry row and its cards** (`rule:programs/constructors`) — a row beside `implementingWith`'s at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/program.rs:107`, no parameters, two written type arguments, and a return type spelling `array<{class: string, make: C}>`. Exempt it from the shape guard at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/registry.rs:4313` the way `implementingWith` is. If `CoreTy` cannot spell a written callable variable, add the smallest variant that can, and say so here.

**The expansion** — beside `expand_with` at `crates/nvs-types/src/program.rs:115`. `is_enumeration` at `crates/nvs-types/src/program.rs:58` gains the member. Each row's `make` is an ordinary closure literal checked at the call site. That needs a recorded `ExprInfo` beside `ProgramInstancesWith` at `crates/nvs-types/src/expr_table.rs:1111`, lowered beside `crates/nvs-ir/src/lower/expr.rs:318`. Set `data/rules/programs/constructors.json` to `shipped` with its `guardedBy` in the same commit.

**Two refusals** — new codes `E0838` (`C` is not a callable type naming its parameters, or does not return `T`) and `E0839` (a class whose constructor the closure does not fit, naming the class, with the ordinary error as a note), next to `E0744` at `crates/nvs-diagnostics/src/lib.rs:3846`. `E0744` is never reported by this member. Pinned by `tests/conformance/reject/program-constructors-names-the-class-whose-constructor-does-not-fit.nvst` and the accept case the goal file names.
**`nvs-lsp` go-to-definition on both type arguments** — `crates/nvs-lsp/src/definition.rs:1070`, the type-position jump `implementing<User>()` already takes.

backlog: Stage 4: the feature proofs for `constructors`, one new example per existing member selecting by an abstract base, and both `about.md` files rewritten whole — the goal file § *Stage 4*.
The two context gaps this session closed: `crates/nvs-ir/src/lower/expr.rs` and `crates/nvs-types/src/expr_table.rs` were missing from `[context] modules`, and are now added.
